name: The Palms Turks and Caicos
positioning: All-suite resort on 12 acres of Grace Bay Beach in Providenciales, built around a serpentine infinity pool and an acre-sized spa
best_for: Families who want suites with kitchens and a kids club on the beach
Travelers who want a pool-and-beach stay with a large spa

facts.text: The Palms is an all-suite resort spanning 12 acres on Grace Bay Beach.
The resort is on the island of Providenciales, steps from the white sands of Grace Bay Beach.
At the spa, mornings begin with yoga and pilates classes, and there are cabanas, a sauna and a steam room.
Life at The Palms centers on the pool, with a swim-up bar, loungers and day beds.
All suites have king-sized beds with custom hand-tufted bedding and a coffee and espresso maker.
Many suites have an in-suite washer/dryer and a full kitchen.
All suites come with spacious balconies, many with ocean views.
Bathrooms have marble floors and showers and deep tubs.
Guests can use a tennis court and bicycles to explore the area.
A 24-hour concierge sets up experiences on the water such as snorkeling or a sunset cruise.
The two signature restaurants are Parallel23 and SiSi Restaurante.

highlights.text: The spa takes up an entire acre of the 12-acre property.
A serpentine infinity pool lies at the heart of the resort.
Penthouses have up to four private balconies and a private Sun Suite with outdoor shower.
A butler service makes sure there is a cooler of iced water beside your sun lounger.
The Conch Kritters Club is the resort's kids club, for ages 4 to 12, with full and half days.

considerations.text: Suites look out either on the Caribbean Ocean or on the landscaped gardens, so not every suite faces the sea.
WhataHotel notes the remote island location requires flight connections.
